title: Layout with Display and Positioning
description: Understanding CSS display properties and positioning techniques for layout.

quiz.question: What is the default value of the CSS 'display' property for most elements?
quiz.explanation: Most elements like <div> default to 'block' display.

quiz.question: Which display value allows elements to sit next to each other but still respect height and width?
quiz.explanation: 'inline-block' lets elements flow inline but keep box model properties.

quiz.question: What does 'display: none;' do to an element?
options: Hides the element and removes it from the layout
Makes the element invisible but still occupies space
Changes the element to block level
quiz.correctAnswer: Hides the element and removes it from the layout
quiz.explanation: 'display: none' removes the element from the page layout entirely.

quiz.question: What is the difference between 'relative' and 'absolute' positioning?
options: Relative positions element relative to its normal position, absolute positions it relative to nearest positioned ancestor
Relative positions element to viewport, absolute to parent
Absolute positions element relative to the document only
quiz.correctAnswer: Relative positions element relative to its normal position, absolute positions it relative to nearest positioned ancestor
quiz.explanation: 'relative' offsets from normal position, 'absolute' positions relative to nearest positioned ancestor.

quiz.question: Which CSS property is used to set an element's stacking order?
quiz.explanation: 'z-index' controls the stack order for overlapping elements.

quiz.question: What does 'position: fixed;' do?
options: Positions element relative to the viewport and stays fixed during scrolling
Positions element relative to its parent
Positions element relative to normal flow
quiz.correctAnswer: Positions element relative to the viewport and stays fixed during scrolling
quiz.explanation: 'fixed' positions an element relative to the viewport and it doesn't move when scrolling.

quiz.question: Which display value makes the element behave like an inline element but allows setting width and height?
quiz.explanation: 'inline-block' elements can have width and height while flowing inline.

quiz.question: What does 'position: static;' mean?
options: Default position, elements follow normal flow
Element is positioned relative to parent
Element is fixed on the screen
quiz.correctAnswer: Default position, elements follow normal flow
quiz.explanation: 'static' is default; elements flow in normal document order.

quiz.question: What is required for an absolutely positioned element to be positioned relative to a specific parent?
options: The parent must have a position value other than static
The parent must have display: block
The parent must have z-index set
The parent must have overflow hidden
quiz.correctAnswer: The parent must have a position value other than static
quiz.explanation: Absolute positioning is relative to the nearest ancestor with a position other than static.

quiz.question: Which CSS property controls how inline content wraps inside a block element?
quiz.explanation: 'white-space' controls how spaces and wrapping behave inside elements.
